```{python}
import pandas as pd

url = "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/byuidatascience/data4names/master/data-raw/names_year/names_year.csv"

df = pd.read_csv(url)
names = pd.read_csv(url)
names.head()
```

```{python}
peter = names[names['name'] == 'Peter'][['year', 'UT', 'OR']]
peter_long = peter.melt(id_vars='year', var_name='state', value_name='count')

ann = pd.DataFrame({
    'year': [1930, 1972, 2005],
    'count': [70, 70, 70],
    'label': ['1930', '1972', '2005']
})

ggplot(peter_long) + \
    geom_line(aes(x='year', y='count', color='state'), size=1.2) + \
    geom_vline(xintercept=1930, color='gray', linetype='dashed') + \
    geom_vline(xintercept=1972, color='gray', linetype='dashed') + \
    geom_vline(xintercept=2005, color='gray', linetype='dashed') + \
    geom_text(aes(x='year', y='count', label='label'), data=ann, hjust=-0.1) + \
    ggtitle("The history of Peter for Utah (red) and Oregon (orange)") + \
    xlab("Year name given") + ylab("Count of Peter") + \
    scale_color_manual(values={"UT": "red", "OR": "orange"}) + \
    theme_minimal()



```

```{python}
import pandas as pd

url = "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/byuidatascience/data4missing/master/data-raw/flights_missing/flights_missing.json"
df = pd.read_json(url)

df['minutes_delayed_carrier'] = df['minutes_delayed_carrier'].fillna(df['minutes_delayed_carrier'].median())
df['minutes_delayed_nas'] = df['minutes_delayed_nas'].fillna(df['minutes_delayed_nas'].median())

std_carrier = df['minutes_delayed_carrier'].std()
std_nas = df['minutes_delayed_nas'].std()

round(max(std_carrier, std_nas), 2)


```
